statistical_unit: 144 geometry units; average paired stream effects within each geometry. Streams, histories, policies and terminal cells are not independent geometry units.
limits: No new simulation, fitting, restoration, prediction, truth evaluation, random draws or threshold changes.
Preserve source outcomes independently of new pathway analysis status.
Saved score differences and rankings are diagnostics, not new predictions or component swaps.
Query and candidate counts are repeated diagnostics, not independent geometries.
Post-discovery verification and requery sequences do not establish necessity or hypothetical success.
Historical cohorts remain separate and are not added to the144-geometry sample.
Path counts are repeated diagnostics; each geometry contributes its two-stream average.
Signed deployment contributions are assigned once to each arm actual deployment, never once per query.
Source scientific summaries, including all controls and undefined baselines, survive path-analysis failures unchanged.
Saved cross-arm score differences are not unrecorded pre/post initialization updates or counterfactual substitutions.
